name: code-runtime-analyzer
description: 把代码结构、产品功能模块和历史运行数据关联起来的分析平台

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix extension ci && npm --prefix web ci
scripts.prepare:extension: npm --prefix web run build && node scripts/prepare-extension.mjs
scripts.test: npm run prepare:test-fixture && npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix extension run compile && npm --prefix web run lint && npm --prefix web run build
